description: This file contains extension methods for configuring grain call filters within the Orleans hosting framework, specifically for adding incoming and outgoing grain call filters to the silo builder.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to add grain call filters to an Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter instance to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a filter implementation type TImplementation to the incoming call filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an incoming call filter via a delegate.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter instance to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a filter implementation type TImplementation to the outgoing call filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an outgoing call filter via a delegate.
